shortDescription: HSBC Holdings LSE:HSBA has set initial price guidance for a planned Japanese yen-denominated Samurai bond sale, according to a term sheet seen on Wednesday.Here's more details:

children: has set initial price guidance for a planned Japanese yen-denominated Samurai bond sale, according to a term sheet seen on Wednesday.
The bank is marketing senior unsecured callable fixed-rate bonds due in 2030, 2032 and 2037. The final size and number of tranches will depend on investor demand.
Initial price guidance was set at 70-75 basis points over yen mid-swaps for the 2030 notes, 90-95 basis points for the 2032 notes and 105-110 basis points for the 2037 notes.
A Samurai bond is a yen-denominated bond issued in Japan by a foreign borrower.
HSBC, Daiwa, Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley, Mizuho, Nomura and SMBC Nikko are arranging the sale.
The bonds are expected to be rated A3 by Moody's and A- by S&P. Pricing is expected on Friday, with settlement scheduled for September 11.
